answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own willow record, and its own share of the grove quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The garden ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 1274 identities would post 909 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
